about_short_description.short_description: Guild is a learning platform that offers classes, programs, and degrees for working adults.

product.name: Guild Talent Advantage
product.description: An employer workforce-development solution combining education benefits, skilling programs, career pathways, coaching, and talent analytics to support employee growth and internal mobility.

product.name: Guild Grow
product.description: An education benefits marketplace offering vetted certificates, credentials, and degree programs aligned with employer needs and in-demand career paths.

product.name: Guild Academy
product.description: A customizable, cohort-based learning service that helps employee teams develop skills and adopt new ways of working together.

product.name: Guild Navigator
product.description: A local, cohort-based talent-development service that prepares employees for licensed and certified roles in specific regions.

product.name: Guild Coaching
product.description: Personalized academic and career coaching for eligible Guild members, including planning, accountability, career guidance, and support connecting education to work.

product.name: Guild Talent Strategy and Analytics
product.description: Advisory and measurement services that align education and skilling programs with workforce priorities and track participation, skills progression, mobility, and business impact.
